turns.question: How many monthly active customers did we have on 3 October 2026?
turns.answer: 10 engaged customers (28 days) on 3 October 2026, counting customers with any site or CRM action in the 28 days ending that day (not customers with a non-cancelled order). Late: customer_actions.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
